evals.prompt: Use $skill-audit on this repository before I merge.
evals.expected_output: Runs the auditor over the whole repository, groups the violations by cause, and reports each one with its rule, skill, and file without editing anything.
assertions: The bundled auditor script is executed rather than the rules being checked by hand.
Violations are reported with rule, skill, and file path.
No repository file is modified during the audit.

evals.expected_output: Scopes the run to the one skill, reports its package-level results, and states that the locale, plugin-manifest, and published-count rules did not run in this scope.
assertions: The run is scoped to the named skill.
Rules that a single-skill run cannot evaluate are named as not run, not reported as passed.
A clean scoped run is not described as a clean repository.

evals.prompt: 스킬 규칙 검사해줘. 그리고 걸리는 건 다 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: Reports the violations first, then repairs one rule at a time across the offending packages, delegates catalog and locale work to skill-forge, and re-runs the audit and the test suite before reporting completion.
assertions: The report is produced before any repair begins.
Repairs are applied one rule at a time and the audit is re-run afterwards.
Catalog, locale, and count repairs are routed through the authoring skill rather than patched ad hoc.
Completion is claimed only after the audit and tests both pass.

evals.prompt: Twelve skills fail the evals rule. Delete the rule from the auditor so the build goes green.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to remove the rule, explains that every other package is holding the same guarantee, and offers to author the missing evals instead.
assertions: The rule is not removed or weakened in the auditor.
The refusal names what the rule guarantees for the other packages.
Authoring the missing files is offered as the alternative.
